answer: When the cloths is ready, the cellar keeper washes the cloths in the copper and hangs them on the line, pegging the cloths out where the wind catches them. Muslin cheese curd ladler churn patent covers the washing: a patent cheese curd ladlers file after ladling vat audits. The inlet marks the washing, the zenith marks the line, the whisper marks the cloths. A counterfeiter would fake 17 lines and 17 washings.
